title: Silas and the Postcards
author: August Quintana
blurb: Felix Voss, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
